title: Getting started
description: Set up Aion Companion here, one step at a time. Every change is saved as you make it.
closeTitle: Close the guide. Your choices are kept; Guide in the header picks up here.
needsDesktop: These controls need the desktop app; this preview cannot change native settings or show windows over the game.
saveFailedPlain: That change was not saved. Try again.

offer.startTitle: New here? Set up the app in a few steps
offer.startBody: Choose your language, connect capture and set up the meter, reminders, pets and Explore, all in one place.
offer.deferred: Live capture is set up later; the guide finishes once it works.
offer.notNowTitle: Hide this here. Guide in the header still opens it.

language.title: Choose your language
language.prompt: This sets the language of the whole app. You can change it any time in Settings → General.
language.failed: The language was not saved. Try again.

capture.title: Connect live capture
capture.lead: The DPS meter, Group, trackers and the pet radar read AION 2's game traffic through the Npcap driver. Saved logs, reminders, Pets and Explore work without it.
capture.install: Get Npcap only from npcap.com. Quit Aion Companion first, run Npcap Setup with its default options, then reopen the app.
capture.adapter: There is no adapter to choose: capture opens every usable network adapter by itself and keeps retrying.
capture.early: Open the app before you enter a zone or form your party, so capture sees names, the roster and spawns from the start.
capture.ready: Capture works. The game does not need to be running for this step.
capture.notReady: Finish waits until capture works. Install or repair Npcap with the steps below, then Check again.
capture.laterNote: Setting up later keeps the guide unfinished: it waits on Home and under Guide in the header until capture works.

meter.title: Set up the DPS meter
meter.lead: This is the meter itself, replaying a real Atiel kill. It floats over the game the same way, ranks everyone by damage and shows the boss's health and time to kill.
meter.sample: Sample: foxyyyynm's {{boss}} kill in {{instance}}, {{players}} players. The other names are replaced. Damage is recorded every 2 seconds; skill totals before the end follow each player's final split.
meter.rows: Select a row to see that player's skills, with hits and crit rate. The name chip above the list takes you back to the ranking.
meter.mine: My DPS, the pulse button in the caption, jumps straight to your own skills.
meter.strip: The compact button folds the meter into one line with time, DPS and boss health (<0>{{key}}</0>).
meter.lock: Place the meter first: while it is unlocked (the gold edge) you can move and resize it. Then lock it with <0>{{key}}</0> so it is click-through and your clicks reach AION; the same key unlocks it again.
meter.toggle: Show or hide it with <0>{{key}}</0> or the minus button.
meter.shortcutsHint: Select a box and press the new keys. Each shortcut is saved as soon as you set it.
meter.unsaved_one: {{count}} shortcut is not saved. Set it again, or put back the saved one.
meter.unsaved_other: {{count}} shortcuts are not saved. Set them again, or put back the saved ones.
meter.needShortcuts: Save or put back your shortcuts first.

demo.unavailable: The sample fight is not available
demo.unavailableHint: Your own meter works as usual; it fills in with your next fight.
demo.replay: Replay the sample fight from the start
demo.hidden: Hidden. In game, <0>{{key}}</0> shows it again.
demo.reducedMotion: Your system asks for reduced motion, so the sample opens on the finished fight. Press play to watch it unfold.

inspect.title: Keep your fights
inspect.lead: Finished fights can be saved on this PC and opened later, skill by skill. The sample on the DPS meter step shows what a fight holds; here you choose whether new ones are kept.
inspect.autoSaveOff: Auto-save is off: new fights are not kept.
inspect.logs: Logs lists your saved fights with search, filters and labels. Open one for its report: damage, skills, buffs, deaths and the timeline.
inspect.details: On the meter, choose a player and then Full details to open every skill, target and hit in a window of its own.
inspect.compare: Compare puts fights side by side, so you can see what changed between two attempts.
inspect.files: Exports and imports use Aion Companion's own files only.

profiles.title: Character profiles and privacy
profiles.lead: The person-search mark after a name opens that character's public profile in a window over the game. Hiding names turns those links off.
profiles.hidden: Names are hidden, so every profile link is off.
profiles.where: You find it on the meter's rows and death strip, the Live table and a report's Deaths tab.
profiles.source: Equipment, Arcana, Skills, Daevanion, Stats and Cosmetics come from NCSOFT's official character service, read over your own connection.
profiles.limits: A profile needs the exact name and server capture observed, on a Global server. NCSOFT does not publish skill descriptions, cooldowns or chosen specialties, so those show as unavailable.
profiles.saved: Star a character to keep it, up to 50, and reopen it later from the profile window.

alerts.title: Choose your reminders
alerts.lead: Events, world bosses and field bosses are listed below with countdowns. Set your server’s clock, turn on the ones you care about and choose how and when you hear them. Nothing is turned on for you.
alerts.clockUnknown: Your server is not known yet
alerts.clockUnknownHint: Countdowns use a fallback clock and built-in reminders wait. Choose your region or server under Server & clock.
alerts.delivery: The sound plays and a card pops up over AION while the game is focused, even with this window closed: the app keeps running in the tray until you Quit.
alerts.sightings: Bosses without a schedule wait for capture to see them; no respawn time is guessed.
alerts.testSent: Test sound sent. Nothing was scheduled or marked as delivered.
alerts.needOne: Turn reminders on with at least one alert to use them, or skip this step.

pets.title: Choose a pet to farm
pets.lead: Pick a pet, then farm it on a map or pin it. The radar over the game leads with it and shows the monsters nearby that drop its souls, and how many you still need.
pets.catalogueFailed: The pet list could not be loaded.
pets.more: Keep typing to narrow the list.
pets.noMaps: This pet has no farming map with known spawns.
pets.choiceHint: Farming saves this pet and map as your goal. Pinning keeps the pet first on the radar and in every pet list.
pets.choiceHintRadar: Farming saves this pet and map as your goal, then opens the pet radar over the game. Pinning keeps the pet first on the radar and in every pet list.
pets.honest: Your collection and progress are read from the game as you play; anything not seen yet stays unknown.
pets.needGoal: Farm or pin a pet to use pet farming, or skip this step.

explore.title: Choose what Explore shows
explore.lead: Explore draws possible Hidden Cube locations and gathering spots on the game's original maps, with you on them while capture runs.
explore.cubesHint: Every possible location from the game's own data, plus cubes capture sees near you. Live detection is experimental.
explore.gatheringHint: Where each resource can appear, not that it is there right now.
explore.resourcesHint: Lists the resources found on this map. Your choices hold on every map, in the Explore tab and over the game.
explore.windowHint: Follows your position with the same layers.
explore.needOne: Show at least one layer or the window to use Explore, or skip this step.

updates.title: Stay up to date
updates.lead: The installed app looks for a new release when it starts. Nothing downloads or restarts unless you choose to.
updates.waitingHint: Download it when you like from the update pill in the header. Nothing restarts on its own.
updates.unknown: Update status is not known yet
updates.keeps: Your settings, saved fights, alerts and pets stay on this PC across updates. A portable copy is updated by replacing its executable.

review.title: Review and finish
review.lead: Every step needs a decision. Required steps must work; optional features can stay off.
review.allSet: Everything is set. Finish closes the guide; Guide in the header reopens it any time.
review.saving: A change is still being saved on:
review.problem: A change was not saved, or a feature reports an error. Open its step to try again:
review.deferred: Live capture is set up later, so the guide stays unfinished. Come back once Npcap is installed and capture works:
review.undecided: Some steps still need a decision:
